Professional Training
Clinical Pharmacy (4 th & 5 th Professions) Clerkship a Total of: | 350 hrs.
An Internship, in any of the given tracks is mandatory for the ward of degree i.e., Pharmaceutical Industry, Community Pharmacy, Hospital / Clinical Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Marketing, Management & Regulatory Affairs a total of: | 350 hrs.

One year of Advanced Pharmacy Practice Experience APPE:

As of Pakistan pharmacy council, in Pharm D syllabus on page 103, our students are required to undergo a residency-based training for a period of one year. Therefore, our students undergo

Compulsory or core rotations
general internal medicines, Ambulatory care, institutional pharmacy practice and community pharmacy practice.

Selective or elective rotations
infectious disease, cardiology, paediatrics, critical care center.

Optional rotations
surgery, oncology, nephrology, transplant, medication safty,TPN, medication safety.
